title: Reflected diffusion, no-flux continuity equations and confined Lagrangian flows in bounded domains
summary: Motivated by marginal distribution flows of reflected diffusions in bounded domains, we investigate when a density/flux pair solving a no-flux continuity equation admits a regular Lagrangian flow that remains in the closed domain and generates the prescribed density flow. We give sufficient conditions in terms of interior bounded-variation regularity, bounded-variation control on a boundary collar, a one-sided bound on an absolutely continuous divergence, and vanishing normal trace of the velocity.
